h1: Panan Krabi Resort — A Resort in the Heart of Ao Nang, an Easy Walk to the Beach and Restaurants
intro: If quiet beachfront villas at Klong Muang are one extreme of Krabi, Ao Nang is the buzzing center where everything is within reach — and Panan Krabi Resort sits right in the middle of it. This 4-star boutique resort of around 199 rooms is about a 5-minute walk from Ao Nang Beach, set right by the walking street, restaurants and a 7-Eleven. Guests most often talk about its three pools — especially the rooftop pool with limestone-cliff views — and a well-reviewed breakfast. From approx. ฿2,800/night.

body.html: Panan Krabi Resort is a mid-size property of around 199 rooms and suites set in the heart of Ao Nang. The selling point every review agrees on is its location — about a 5-minute walk to Ao Nang Beach, right by Ao Nang Walking Street with restaurants, massage shops, bars and convenience stores all around. For travelers who want to explore Krabi without relying on a car for every outing, stepping out the door and finding everything within walking distance is an edge that quiet out-of-town beach resorts simply can't match.

Rooms come in several tiers, from standard, modern Deluxe rooms with a balcony over the pool or garden, up to Pool Access rooms where you can step straight from your terrace into the water, and Family/suite layouts for groups. Many reviews praise the rooms as bigger than expected and clean. But there's an honest caveat: room quality isn't consistent across the board — some guests found older bathroom fixtures, weak water pressure, or a musty smell. If you're given a room that isn't right, it's worth asking to switch straight away.
"Less than a ten-minute walk to the beach, then back for an evening swim in the rooftop pool with the limestone cliffs against the sky — fantastic value for this kind of location."

The real star here is the three pools. The main pool is a lagoon style set among tropical gardens, there's a separate kids' pool, and the highlight is a rooftop pool with a bar and an evening happy hour, looking out over Ao Nang's limestone cliffs. Many guests say the rooftop pool at sunset is the best part of a stay here. Breakfast at the D-Plee restaurant also earns praise for a varied buffet with both Thai and international options.

Service is another consistent strength in the reviews — staff are warm, attentive and multilingual. The resort also has its own app for ordering room service and booking tours, which many guests appreciate. There's a spa, fitness center and kids' club, so it works for both couples and families. Overall it feels like good value for what you get in the Ao Nang area.

The thing to weigh carefully is noise. Because the resort sits right on Ao Nang's busy main road, several reviews note that street-facing rooms pick up traffic and late-night noise that can disturb sleep → if you're a light sleeper, ask for an inner room facing the pool or garden. The other point is room views not matching expectations — some guests who paid for a sea view got a less scenic outlook, since the resort isn't directly on the beach, so any sea view is a distant angle rather than the sands in front of your room.

With 9.1 from 614 reviews on Trip.com, 8.6 on Booking.com from over 2,700 reviews, and 4.6/5 on TripAdvisor (ranked #8 of 202 Ao Nang hotels), Panan suits travelers who value a central Ao Nang location, good pools and strong value over a private luxury beachfront. The tip is to choose a pool- or garden-facing room to escape the road noise and not to expect a picture-perfect sea view — but on location and value, this place genuinely delivers.

honestSummary: Panan Krabi Resort is a strong pick for travelers who value a central Ao Nang location, good pools and value over a private beachfront resort. The walk to the beach and restaurants, warm service and rooftop pool are what guests remember — but you do have to accept road noise, sea views that don't quite match the listing, and inconsistent room quality.
honestChecks: If you're a light sleeper or sensitive to noise — the resort sits on Ao Nang's busy main road, lively at night → request an inner room facing the pool/garden and avoid lower street-facing floors.

If you want a real sea view from your room or to step onto the beach from the hotel — Panan isn't directly on the beach and any sea view is a distant angle → for true beachfront, look at resorts on Tubkaak or Klong Muang instead.
If you get a room with older fixtures or a musty smell — room quality varies → ask the front desk to switch at check-in, and book a free-cancellation rate as a safety net.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Panan Krabi Resort

faq.q: Where is Panan Krabi Resort, and can you walk to the beach?
faq.a: It's in the heart of Ao Nang at 945 Moo 2, Mueang Krabi · about a 5-minute walk to Ao Nang Beach, right by Ao Nang Walking Street with restaurants, massage shops and a 7-Eleven · around 30 minutes by car from Krabi Airport (KBV) · a location where you can explore with barely any need for a car.

faq.q: How much does Panan Krabi Resort cost, and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Rates start from approx. ฿2,800/night for a standard Deluxe room · stepping up to Deluxe Premier Pool View, Pool Access rooms where you slide straight into the pool from your terrace, and a Family Two-Bedroom Suite · prices vary by season and package, so always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is Panan Krabi Resort best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for travelers who want to be in central Ao Nang, walk to the beach and restaurants, and get strong value · with a rooftop pool and kids' club it works for couples and families alike · it's less suited to those wanting a quiet, private beachfront resort, since it sits on a busy road and isn't directly on the beach.

faq.q: Are the rooms noisy, and how should I choose one?
faq.a: Because the resort is on Ao Nang's busy main road, street-facing rooms can pick up traffic and late-night noise · if you sleep lightly, ask for an inner room facing the pool or garden and avoid lower street-facing floors · stating your preference at booking helps you land a better room.

faq.q: What are the pools like — is there really a rooftop pool?
faq.a: Yes — there are 3 pools: a lagoon-style main pool among the gardens, a separate kids' pool, and a rooftop pool with a bar and evening happy hour looking out over Ao Nang's limestone cliffs · the rooftop pool at sunset is the highlight guests mention most.

faq.q: How far ahead should I book, and is cancellation flexible?
faq.a: In high season (November–April), book 3–6 weeks ahead, especially Pool Access and family rooms, which sell out fast · most platforms offer a Free Cancellation option — choose that if your plans aren't firm, or in case you need to request a room change at check-in.
